4. It has been held by a Coordinate Bench in Writ-C No. 41540 of 2023 (Pawan Kumar Rajbhar vs.
Union of India and 2 others) and other connected matters decided on 19.01.2024 that in such an event, it is open to the person concerned to seek no-objection from the jurisdictional criminal court in respect of grant of passport and the Regional Passport Officer shall act, accordingly.
5.

sentences.text: In view of the aforesaid position, we dispose of the writ petition with liberty to the petitioner to apply before the concerned court for no-objection and in case, the same is granted, the Regional Passport Officer shall proceed to take further action in the matter taking into notice the no-objection granted by the court.

6. It is clarified that in one of the cases where the proceedings have been stayed by order dated 11.11.2024 by this Court in Application U/S 482 No. 20345 of 2024, the stay of the proceedings shall not be an impediment in entertaining application for grant of no-objection.
